verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs describe one-off 'Scheduled Rollouts' for gradually deploying a feature gate over time and CLI/CI-CD integration, but there is no evidence of a mechanism for scheduling recurring jobs or workflows (e.g., cron-like recurring automation) as a platform capability. missing for 10: any documented recurring/cron scheduling feature, workflow orchestration, or automation-job scheduler beyond one-time gradual rollout.
